title: My first weeks in MDS
text: My first few weeks within the MDS program have been amazing. The people and faculty are awsome! Even coming from a computer and data science backround I have learned alot and refine some skills that I had spead though or glossed over in my undergrad. A strong foundation is very inportant in anything and I alwys reach for an opertunity to refine my own.

title: About
text: I grew up in British Columbia and spent my undergrad years in Kelowna. Most of my time there went into building things: a capstone project where a team of seven of us built a TA allocation and management system for a university department, and an ongoing deep learning project on reading jersey numbers off soccer and hockey video. Alongside school I do freelance web development, and over the past year I have redesigned and rebuilt the portfolio sites for two different companies, which taught me as much about talking to clients as it did about code.

title: About
text:
Why data science
The turning point was a course project where the hard part was not the model, it was figuring out what the data actually meant. I liked that the answer was not in the assignment and had to be argued for. Coming from a software background, I am comfortable building the pipelines and interfaces around data, but I wanted to be the person deciding what goes through them rather than the one plumbing it together, and that is what pulled me toward statistics and modelling.
